CoreFeatures.title: Core Features of our cloud secure storage
CoreFeatures.description: Complete security for your data, everything you need to keep your files secure and private

titles: Your cloud, like a local drive
descriptions: Internxt bundles encrypted storage, backups, VPN, Antivirus, Cleaner, Meet, Mail & more—everything to break free from Big Tech.
Send files with encrypted links, passwords, and controls. Work with your team in real time while keeping data private.
Use Internxt as a virtual drive to sync, upload, and access files seamlessly—just like on your computer, but fully secure and always up to date.
All files are encrypted with post-quantum and zero-knowledge encryption. Nobody but you, or those you choose to share files with, can see its contents.
You control exactly who can access your shared files with encrypted, password-protected links you can revoke anytime.
Ensure your files stay safe from ransomware and accidental loss with scheduled, encrypted backups that provide extra protection and peace of mind.

faq.question: How do I get the Internxt Early Black Friday Discount?
answer: To claim your discount, choose from our Essential, Premium, or Ultimate plan and head to the checkout page. Your {{discount}}% discount is automatically applied at checkout.

faq.question: When does the Early Black Friday Internxt Deal end?
answer: The Early Black Friday sale ends November 22nd, 2026.

faq.question: Who is eligible for this discount?
answer: If you're a new user, you can enjoy this discount by creating an account. If you have a lifetime plan, you can upgrade to get more storage and the extra features such as Cleaner, Meet, and Mail.

faq.question: Will I keep my discount when my plan ends?
answer: The Early Black Friday deal is valid until the end of the subscription period. Your subscription will automatically renew at the regular price once this subscription period ends at the end of the year. As lifetime plans only require one payment, your discount will last forever.

faq.question: What payment methods does Internxt accept?
answer: Currently, we accept payments via credit and debit cards (including Mastercard, VISA, American Express, and more), and we also accept Paypal, bankcontact, iDEAL, and SOFORT.

faq.question: Have more questions?
